nodes.description: Privileged address granted upgrade authorization rights; set to msg.sender in initialize and mutable through setUpgrader.
Stored NFT collection name, written once during initialize.
Stored NFT collection symbol, written once during initialize.
Monotonic counter used as the token id for newly added metadata entries.
Public mapping from token id to IPFS metadata hash.
Owner address controlling onlyOwner gated functions.
Flag recording that the contract has been initialized.
Flag recording that an initializer call is currently in progress.
Immutable address of this implementation, used by onlyProxy to detect delegatecall context.
Initializer that sets name, symbol and assigns upgrader = msg.sender; guarded by the initializer modifier.
Upgrade authorization hook restricted by onlyUpgrader; the sole access control gate on the UUPS upgrade path.
View function returning _name.
View function returning _symbol.
onlyOwner function that stores an IPFS hash at nextTokenId and increments the counter.

Modifier requiring msg.sender == upgrader before executing the guarded function body.
Modifier requiring owner() == _msgSender() before executing the guarded function body.

onlyOwner function transferring ownership to newOwner after a zero-address check.
onlyOwner function setting the owner to address(0).
Internal helper that reads the old owner, writes the new owner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Initializer that seeds _owner with _msgSender().

Payable onlyProxy entry point that authorizes an upgrade and executes the supplied data.
Performs the upgrade, the rollback security test and the optional delegatecall setup call.
Private helper performing target.delegatecall(data) into the new implementation.
Validates the new implementation is a contract and writes the EIP1967 implementation slot.
Sets the new implementation and emits the Upgraded event.
Modifier/guard that permits initialization only once and tracks nested initialization state.
Attacker-controllable caller identity used for upgrader assignment and all authorization checks.
Low-level delegatecall executing arbitrary calldata in the proxy storage context.

Caller-supplied symbol passed into initialize.

Caller-supplied address that becomes the new owner.

edges.reason: initialize assigns msg.sender to the privileged upgrader slot, so the first caller seizes upgrade rights.
initialize writes the upgrader state variable from the untrusted caller identity.
initialize stores the provided name into _name.
initialize stores the provided symbol into _symbol.
initialize flips the _initialized guard to prevent re-initialization.
initialize sets and clears the _initializing flag while executing.
__Ownable_init seeds _owner with _msgSender(), granting ownership to the deployer/caller.
initializer modifier writes _initialized to block repeat initialization.
initializer modifier toggles _initializing around the guarded body.
onlyUpgrader compares msg.sender with the stored upgrader address.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender with the stored owner address.
onlyUpgrader gates execution of setUpgrader.
onlyUpgrader gates the _authorizeUpgrade hook used by the UUPS upgrade path.
_authorizeUpgrade reads the upgrader state variable through the onlyUpgrader modifier.
onlyOwner gates execution of transferOwnership.
onlyOwner gates execution of renounceOwnership.
transferOwnership ultimately rewrites the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership delegates the ownership write to _setOwner.
_setOwner writes the new owner address into _owner.
renounceOwnership calls _setOwner with address(0).
upgradeTo calls the authorization hook before performing the upgrade.
upgradeToAndCall calls the authorization hook before performing the upgrade.
upgradeTo delegates the upgrade mechanics to _upgradeToAndCallSecure.
upgradeToAndCall delegates the upgrade mechanics and setup call to _upgradeToAndCallSecure.
The upgrade flow performs a delegatecall into the new implementation, giving it full control of proxy storage.
_functionDelegateCall reaches the raw delegatecall sink with caller-influenced target and data.
_upgradeToAndCallSecure writes the EIP1967 implementation slot via _setImplementation.
_upgradeToAndCallSecure calls _upgradeTo to finalize and emit the upgrade.
_upgradeTo internally invokes _setImplementation.
add reads nextTokenId to assign the returned id and then increments it.
add writes the supplied hash into ipfsHashes at the current token id.
tokenURI reads ipfsHashes[tokenId] to build the metadata URI.
name reads the _name state variable.
symbol reads the _symbol state variable.
Caller-provided name_ flows into initialize and is persisted in _name.
Caller-provided symbol_ flows into initialize and is persisted in _symbol.
Caller-provided ipfsHash flows into add and is stored in ipfsHashes.
Caller-provided tokenId is used to index ipfsHashes in tokenURI.
Caller-provided upgrader_ becomes the new privileged upgrader address.
Caller-provided newOwner becomes the new owner with full control over onlyOwner functions.
The new implementation address reaches the _authorizeUpgrade gate.
upgradeTo forwards the caller-supplied implementation address into the upgrade routine.
upgradeToAndCall forwards the caller-supplied implementation address into the upgrade routine.
Caller-supplied data is executed as part of the upgrade via the setup call.
Target address flows into _functionDelegateCall and is used for the delegatecall.
Local tokenId receives nextTokenId and is returned from add.
Local oldOwner caches the previous owner for the event in _setOwner.
Local isTopLevelCall drives the _initializing reset logic in the initializer modifier.
Local success captures the delegatecall result in _functionDelegateCall.
